findings.title: Live-PG writer tests never selected by make target
findings.problem: test_session_sort_keys.py and test_session_sort_keys_backfill.py skip without TEST_LOCAL_PG_URL, and test-cli-analytics-live runs only '-k live'; neither the file names nor test names contain 'live'. Plain pytest skips them too.
findings.impact: Regressions in the SQL writing cache_read_total, classifier_names, cost_key and the rates_version stamp ship green, and readers trust those stamps. The target's skipped-test guard never sees these modules.
findings.recommendation: Rename the files to test_live_session_sort_keys*.py or widen the Makefile -k expression to include them.

findings.title: Stored statements do not use the new sort indexes (AC8)
findings.problem: Real stored ctx/cost/framework statements join session_dims from sel and sort the merged key, so they Seq Scan session_dims; the strict-xfail EXPLAIN test and bench-results.md record this. Only hand-written probe queries use the indexes; no EXPLAIN exists for the cost or framework statements; PG14 status is undocumented. The a1c1a0000012 docstring still claims an in-order index walk.
findings.impact: Required criterion AC8 is unmet; four indexes (about 78-123 MB, HOT ratio 0.0, build lock, write amplification) are paid for without serving the readers. Reachability not independently re-verified.
findings.recommendation: Restructure the stored statements so the indexes serve them and assert it with EXPLAIN per sel arm, or obtain explicit approval for the limitation and drop or justify the indexes; document PG14 and correct the migration docstring.

findings.title: Refresher stamps zero costs under empty catalog
findings.problem: _write_sort_keys checks only that rates and rates_version are set, not that the version differs from EMPTY_RATES_VERSION; maintenance.py:343 and sort_keys_cli.py:106 both refuse to derive in that case.
findings.impact: With an empty or not-yet-loaded catalog sessions are stamped with zero cost under the empty version, which readers on that version trust; a full reprice follows once the catalog loads.
findings.recommendation: Compute the version first and return early when it equals EMPTY_RATES_VERSION, as maintenance does.

findings.title: enable --since skips stamps with NULL activity columns
findings.problem: _ACTIVE_SINCE requires last_event_at or last_activity_day to be at or after the cutoff; a stamped session with both NULL, written while the switch was off, matches neither. FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED rows are also never revisited and not reported. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.impact: Stale stamps survive enable and stored readers serve outdated ctx/cost/framework values for those sessions.
findings.recommendation: Treat both-NULL rows as active (or null their stamps), and report or retry skipped locked rows in the returned count and audit line.

findings.title: AC9/AC10 measurements missing from bench results
findings.problem: bench-results.md records no re-price duration or S-merge duration (S never non-empty in the bench), no ingest acquire-wait p99/503 baseline, no framework group count. The 825 ms target is missed for ctx/cost/framework and left as a limitation for approval. The bench and guide also contradict each other (claims of stored beating fallback at every window, index size delta, 5 s versus 10 s versus 30 s timeout).
findings.impact: Required acceptance criteria AC9 and AC10 are partial; the roll-out path where S is non-empty is unmeasured.
findings.recommendation: Measure re-price time and S-merge under load with a non-empty S, add the ingest baseline and framework group count, reconcile the contradictory figures, and record the explicit approval of the missed targets.
